fields.description: Issue includes Wen R. Phillips' "Notebook" column criticizing high telephone rates and calling for action and investigation involving the Florida Railroad Commission and related figures; local commentary on jail/court conditions and a drunk-driving case; discussion of milk price regulation; extensive horse-racing coverage and advertisements including "Jockey Jimmy" selections for Tropical Park following Hialeah; nightlife and entertainment listings and club promotions; commentary on movie-industry schemes; letters to the editor including one retracting criticism of Florida Power & Light and another supporting criticism of government regulation; and home modernization/FHA plumbing improvement advertisements.
